H2(F3) is contained in top chain C2 because C3=0, so splitting contradicts the sign-free chain argument. Verified finite-field ranks and all 105 stabilizers.

value.rationale: Natural first torsion-bearing complete-graph matching complex, with a canonical equivariant UCT extension that demonstrably fails to split. This gives structural modular information not implied by numerical homology groups or rational characters; the sign-stabilizer obstruction identifies a meaningful boundary between vector-space and group-equivariant splittings.
